description.value: Osaka Sushi is a Japanese restaurant on Hastings Street in Burnaby offering an extensive menu spanning nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, ramen, udon, tempura, and donburi. The restaurant serves beer and house wine alongside its food menu. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with online ordering through the restaurant's own website.
